lines.q: Which animal is called man's best friend?
lines.a: The dog! Loyal for over fifteen thousand years.

lines.q: What is a baby frog called?
lines.a: A tadpole! Tail first, legs later.

lines.q: How many sides does a stop sign have?
Which fruit wears its seeds on the outside?
lines.a: The strawberry! Around two hundred tiny seeds.

lines.q: How many hours are in two days?
lines.a: Forty eight! Easy maths, if you didn't panic.

lines.q: Last one. Where was Hawaiian pizza invented?
lines.a: Canada! In Ontario, back in nineteen sixty two. Got all six? Go again!
